research_mode: official ONS and Home Office sources only; current YE March 2026 crime and outcomes measurements with explicit survey, recording, cohort-maturity and transition limitations; no parcel result or safety score claimed

sources.name: Fraud chapter deferred
verified_claims: the 2025 to 2026 outcomes bulletin excludes the fraud chapter
the chapter will be released later after Report Fraud transition work
limitations: the omission is not a zero-value result

sources.name: Weapon subset relationship
verified_claims: knife and firearm offences are subsets of other offence categories
they are also included within victim-based or non-victim-based totals
limitations: weapon subsets must not be added to total offences as separate categories

sources.name: Robbery charge rate
verified_claims: robbery charge or summons rate rose from 7.5% to 10.5%
limitations: rate changes depend on case maturity and recording practices

sources.name: Theft charge rate
verified_claims: theft charge or summons rate rose from 7.3% to 9.1%
limitations: the rate is outcome status at the reporting snapshot

sources.name: Sexual offence evidential difficulties
verified_claims: 47.6% of sexual offences received an evidential-difficulties outcome
limitations: the figure does not imply that no offence occurred

sources.name: Rape evidential difficulties
verified_claims: 51.7% of rape offences received an evidential-difficulties outcome
limitations: the rate is affected by case complexity and victim engagement

sources.name: All victim-based evidential difficulties
verified_claims: 39.0% of all victim-based offences received an evidential-difficulties outcome
limitations: offence-group mix affects the aggregate rate

sources.name: Rape charge timing
verified_claims: rape charge or summons outcomes took an average of 438 days
violence against the person took 55 days
theft took 27 days
limitations: timeliness comparisons are not direct efficiency rankings

sources.name: Rape year-end charge rate
verified_claims: 3.4% of rape offences had a charge or summons outcome at year-end
the rate is expected to rise as cases mature
limitations: initial-year rates are incomplete cohort outcomes

sources.name: Victim-based no-suspect closure
verified_claims: 40.9% of victim-based offences closed with no suspect identified
the previous-year figure was 42.1%
limitations: closure reason is not a crime-frequency measure

sources.name: Theft no-suspect closure
verified_claims: 69.4% of theft offences closed with no suspect identified
limitations: the rate reflects investigation outcomes, not incident prevalence

sources.name: Non-victim evidential difficulties
verified_claims: 35.6% of non-victim-based offences closed for evidential difficulties
the previous-year figure was 37.2%
limitations: non-victim-based offences have a different offence mix

sources.name: Non-victim no-suspect closure
verified_claims: 22.8% of non-victim-based offences closed with no suspect identified
the previous-year figure was 22.3%
limitations: aggregate rates are not comparable to parcel-level safety

sources.name: Non-victim out-of-court disposal
verified_claims: 12.1% of non-victim-based offences received an out-of-court disposal
the previous-year figure was 11.0%
limitations: formal and informal disposals require outcome-code detail

sources.name: Non-victim under investigation
verified_claims: 9.5% of non-victim-based offences remained under investigation
the previous-year figure was 10.9%
